Conformance.Builtin.Semantics.IntegerToByteString.BigEndian.Bounded

Conformance tests generated from plutus-conformance/test-cases/uplc/evaluation/builtin/semantics/integerToByteString/big-endian/bounded. See Conformance.Eval for how they are run.

open import Conformance.Eval

correct-output-exact-width

-- builtin/semantics/integerToByteString/big-endian/bounded/correct-output-exact-width
-- Check that a particular integer encodes to the expected bytestring using exactly the right width.
test-correct-output-exact-width : Untyped
test-correct-output-exact-width = (UApp (UApp (UApp (UBuiltin integerToByteString) (UCon (tagCon bool true))) (UCon (tagCon integer (ℤ.pos 6)))) (UCon (tagCon integer (ℤ.pos 20016001699311))))

expected-correct-output-exact-width : Result
expected-correct-output-exact-width = success (UCon (tagCon bytestring (mkByteString "\DC24V\171\205\239")))

-- Pending: bytestring constant; postulated builtin `integerToByteString`.
pending-correct-output-exact-width : Set
pending-correct-output-exact-width = Pending (evalRaw test-correct-output-exact-width ≡ expected-correct-output-exact-width)

correct-output-extra-width
